### Issue Details
## Issue #219

## What to build

Verify and fix the data mapping between the backend sales table (`server/src/db/schema.ts`) and the frontend Sales History view. The ID, date, and total fields are currently missing or displaying incorrect values. Ensure these core metrics render accurately in the UI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Sale `id` (Sale #) renders correctly for each row
- [ ] `created_at` timestamp formats to a readable local date/time string (`en-IE`)
- [ ] `total_gross` displays as a properly formatted EUR currency value
- [ ] No fields show `null`, `undefined`, or NaN in the rendered table
- [ ] Frontend types (`SaleRecord`) match backend API response shape exactly

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately





## REVIEWER COMPLETED
reviewer rejected

• SalesHistoryPage.tsx accesses sale.sale_number, sale.created_at, sale.customer_id, sale.total_gross which are all undefi
